claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive (ClassFeatureMechanics family)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Superior Critical is a permanent always-on modifier with no activation cost, no use-count resource, and no reset cadence. The existing ClassFeatureMechanics only has the 'activation' family, which requires all three. A new 'passive' family is needed for features that silently modify combat resolution without being activated.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can now score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18–20 on the d20.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_crit_threshold
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The mechanic widens the d20 range that counts as a Critical Hit from 20 to 18–20. No existing v4 effect atom covers this. TAXONOMY_atoms_graph.md §12 notes 'crit_window distinct from on_hit_window' as a deferred residue atom (single-feat pressure from Boon of Irresistible Offense). Superior Critical and Improved Critical (L3) now add two more pressure streams for this atom.
